rules.alias_policy: Aliases of three characters or fewer, and aliases that are ordinary English or Vietnamese words, must either be unambiguous technical acronyms (kubernetes 'k8s') or carry an `ambiguous` block: exact surface `forms` and/or nearby `cues`. Generic phrases that merely co-occur with a skill (cross-platform, release, event-driven, reconciliation, creativity, integrity) are not aliases. Certifications need the word certificate/certified/chung chi or an exact exam code. 'architect' never implies Lead.
